glossary.note: The 25 election terms in i18n/GLOSSARY.md were checked by an anonymous Hausa speaker and separately attested by the project owner. The UI strings below reuse those terms but have NOT themselves been read by a speaker.

_meta.note: UI strings are a language-model draft. reviewers/target track the corroboration the owner asked for: 2-3 speakers per language. Set review to 'provisional' when the first speaker signs off on the UI strings, and to 'human' when the target is met.
_meta.priorityNote: Read these first. The first four are evidential or irreversible-action warnings; the rest either carry the INEC notice as a trailing clause or tell an observer a hard rule they must not misunderstand. None of the interface strings has been read by a speaker yet.
_meta.coverage: All 40 pages plus the runtime shell chrome. Not covered: the first-run tour in menu.js, and backend SMS/OTP/Telegram/push text.

tour.note: Hawkeye tana da zaman kanta kuma ba ta goyon bayan kowace jam'iyya. Ba ta da alaƙa da INEC ko wata hukumar gwamnati, kuma ba ta sanar da sakamako — tana rubuta abin da masu lura suka kai rahoto, tana kuma ba kowa damar duba littafin.
tour.report.body: Kai rahoton takardar sakamako, sakamakon tattarawa, ko wani lamari. Wannan shi ne abin da ke sa ka zama mai lura.
